sources.title: WSL 2.7.14 startup
sources.observation: StartTimeSyncAgent writes PHC configuration and launches /sbin/chronyd from mini_init; live config and parent PID match. Source review supports observed ownership.

sources.title: WSL 2.7.14 namespace helper
sources.observation: Default child-process helper uses fork; distro creation uses separate namespaces. Explains ancestor daemon visibility.

sources.title: WSL 2.7.14 debug client
sources.observation: Debug console requires elevated Windows token; streams console input/output without restarting VM.

sources.title: Chrony upstream 4.5 scheduler
sources.observation: External-step detection uses a 10-second threshold; subsecond Docker steps may evade it. This is source-supported inference, not reproduced complete estimator feedback or binary/source certification.

sources.title: Chrony upstream 4.5 kernel adjustment
sources.observation: Frequency driver changes tick and frequency; retained estimate slows adjusted clocks. The controlled trial independently tests rate causality.

sources.title: Chrony upstream 4.5 shutdown
sources.observation: Finalisation preserves base frequency while cancelling fast slew. Stopping a daemon alone does not guarantee neutral kernel rate.

sources.title: WSL configuration reference
sources.observation: Reviewed configuration table offers no documented toggle for this mini_init chronyd. Timezone selection is not clock-rate repair; restart applies persistent WSL settings.

sources.title: Chrony 4.5 command reference
sources.observation: reset sources discards measurement history; alone it is not proven prevention of repeated controller interference. No reset sources or makestep was run.
